item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01040","case1_error":"Evaluates 22 − 7/3 incorrectly as 22 2/3 and answers in yards instead of requested feet.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported final count 24,000 after correct pixel formulas; those formulas yield 2,520,000.","reason":"Case 1 shows an explicit subtraction evaluation error and wrong units; case 2 provides an incorrect final number without showing its calculation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01041","case1_error":"Treats each two-dozen set as 12 cups, omitting the factor of two.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 9 + 9 + 9 + 8 + 8 + 8 as 49 instead of 51.","reason":"Case 1 constructs the total using an incorrect set size; case 2 correctly constructs the sum but evaluates it incorrectly.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01042","case1_error":"Provides unsupported final answer 6186 after correct formulas that yield 859 balloons per school.","case2_error":"Incorrectly multiplies the first round's eight games by four rounds; also evaluates its resulting expression as 41 instead of 39.","reason":"Case 1 has an unsupported final number following correct formulas. Case 2 explicitly uses an erroneous counting relation and miscalculates that expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01043","case1_error":"Leading answer marker says 20, but the correct derivation and concluding answer give 16.","case2_error":"Reports unsupported revenue of 168; the stated revenue procedure should yield 216.","reason":"Case 1 contains only an answer-marker conflict with an otherwise correct derivation, requiring an uncertain judgment.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J01044","case1_error":"Uses three grams per smaller antacid instead of one, confusing the pill count with individual weight.","case2_error":"Represents Gordon's unequal bag weights with one variable and substitutes three pounds for both, discarding the seven-pound weight.","reason":"Case 1 substitutes a count for a unit weight; case 2 collapses two explicitly unequal weights into a single shared value.","judgment":"different"}]}
